what_happened: The job stopped writing Athena- trailers in commits after cutover C0. It was rejected: 2 of 8 acceptance criteria were unmet, with 2 major findings. No failed checks are listed. The first unmet criterion needs a scratch-repo test where the landing record classifies three commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing, and check_history and check_attribution pass on the post-C0 base. The finding says check_history does not pass there. The test asserts that it reports violations (gh.rs:5131-5156). The second unmet criterion needs status and audit to still read trailers up to and including C0, with a C0..head fallback, giving the same results as before. The finding says the fallback in athena trace (status.rs) and the auditor (auditor.rs) has no test. The other 6 criteria were met.
cause: Nothing in code makes the producer check, before handover, that each criterion has a passing test that asserts the criterion's stated outcome. The producer wrote a test that asserts the opposite result, that check_history reports violations, and it left the fallback readers with no test. Only the verifier's judgment at the final verdict catches this, and there rejection is the only outcome. A history-walking change like this one touches several readers (check_history, status, auditor), and nothing lists them and maps a test to each. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer ran or wrote.
prevention: Add a pre-handover check that runs after the producer finishes and before the verifier. For each acceptance criterion it requires a named test or command. It runs them and refuses handover if one fails or is missing. It also flags tests whose assertion contradicts the criterion's expected outcome, such as an assertion that a check reports violations when the criterion says the check passes. For changes to shared history or trailer logic, it requires an inventory of the readers (check_history, check_attribution, status, auditor), each with a covering test. A failing or missing entry returns the job to the producer and does not reject it.
proposed_request: Finish stopping Athena- trailers in commits after cutover C0. Outcome: on a scratch repository with commits before and after C0, (1) the landing record classifies the three post-C0 commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing; (2) check_history and check_attribution both pass on the post-C0 base, with a test that asserts they pass and reports no violations; (3) athena trace (status.rs) and the auditor (auditor.rs) still read trailers on commits up to and including C0, and use the C0..head fallback after it, giving the same results as before, with a test for each reader that covers both sides of C0. In the change description, list every reader and writer of trailers and the test that covers each, and cite the commands actually run (cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check, cargo test). Do not change behavior for pre-C0 history.
